research_question: Under the continuous-ECG task contract, how much of the current full-window failure is attributable to the OUTPUT AND NORMALIZATION DEFINITION alone -- a sigmoid head trained against per-window min-max ECG -- rather than to decoder capacity?
hypothesis: Registered before running: B1 (linear output + train-fold robust scaler) will improve full-waveform validation PCC and, more strongly, NRMSE/MAE/R2 over B0 on MMECG development folds. If B1 does not improve, the deficit is not primarily the output definition and B2 becomes the priority.
primary_task: Full-window continuous ECG, 1600 samples at 200 Hz, same time span as the input window. Shape-200 is auxiliary and reported but never used for selection.
primary_ground_truth: Raw ECG under a GLOBAL robust scaler (median / IQR) whose statistics are fitted on TRAINING FOLDS ONLY. Per-window and per-cycle min-max normalization are prohibited as primary GT.

arms.B0: Frozen-recipe REM-Net full-window branch exactly as it stands: sigmoid output, per-window min-max ECG target. Reference point only; its existing checkpoints are NOT overwritten and a new output directory is used.
arms.B1: Identical architecture and budget, two coupled changes: final activation sigmoid -> LINEAR, and target per-window min-max -> train-fold global robust scaler. These cannot be separated because a linear head against a [0,1] target is ill-posed; the pairing is declared here as a single factor.

single_factor_note: B0 vs B1 varies output activation and target normalization together, by necessity. This is stated as a coupled factor rather than claimed as a clean single-variable ablation.
crrvs_note: CR_RVS is NOT run in this pilot. It is validated independently only after a direction is established on MMECG, and must never trigger changes to the shared trunk.

checkpoint_selection.rule: FIXED BEFORE RUNNING, never adjusted after seeing test data. Select the epoch maximizing the full-waveform validation composite S computed against the primary GT of this spec.
checkpoint_selection.definitions: NRMSE_clipped = min(NRMSE, 1) with NRMSE = RMSE / IQR of the scaled GT; R2_clipped = max(R2, 0); R-peak F1 at 100 ms from peaks detected on the RECONSTRUCTED WAVEFORM (waveform-derived readout), not from the event head.
checkpoint_selection.prohibited: Selection on Shape-200 PCC, on any test-split quantity, or on any metric not listed here.

controlled_variables: Architecture (except the declared output change), encoder, TCN, event head and its loss weight, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, 80-epoch cap, patience 20, seed 42, preprocessing, windowing, folds, and the evaluator.
aggregation: Per window, then fold mean, then fold-macro mean +/- std over the three development folds. Folds reported separately.

decision.B1_improves: If B1 improves the composite and does not degrade waveform PCC or NRMSE on 3/3 folds, the deficit is substantially the output/normalization definition. Carry B1 forward as the base for B2.
decision.B1_neutral_or_worse: The output definition is not the primary limitation. Proceed to B2, which carries the input-representation fix (native-rate rcg path) per the architecture design, since the 15 Hz WSST bound is already measured.
decision.either_way: This pilot does not authorize B2-B5. A preflight check gates that decision.

prohibitions: No test split is read by the trainer or the evaluator in this pilot.
No existing experiment directory or checkpoint is modified or deleted; B0 runs to a NEW output directory.
No manuscript claim may be derived from this pilot; it is development evidence.
No comparison against radarODE-MTL numbers pending docs/RADARODE_REPRODUCTION_AUDIT.md remediation.
